div.head: VI Atr 32
div.ab: swa ymbe friþes bote, swa þam bondan sy selost ⁊ þam þeofan sy laþost,
swa ymbe fryðes bote, swa beo þam bóndan selost ⁊ þam þeofan sy laðost,
Swa ymbe friþes bote swa þam bondan sy selost ⁊ þam þeofan sy laþost;
Swa ymbe friþes bote, swa þam bondan sy selost and þam þeofan sy laþost.
so auf die Sicherheitsrechtsform, wie dem Hausvater (bäuerlichen Wirthe) am liebsten und den Dieben am leidesten sei,
on public security, in the way that is best for the householder (the farmer) and most hateful to thieves,
Public security shall be promoted in such a way as shall be best for the householder and worst for the thief.
Public safety is to be improved such that it is best for the citizen and worst for the thief.

note.seg: Bessere Druckfehler: ‘-reform’.—Herstellung öffentlicher Sicherheit, nicht bloss ‘peace of private householders’ (Pollock Oxford lect. 72) ist gemeint, laut der Lat. Übersetzer zu II Cn 8; vgl. Gl Frieden 1b

Correct the misprint: ‘-reform’.—What is meant is the restoration of public security, not merely the ‘peace of private householders’ (Pollock Oxford lect. 72), according to the Latin translators of II Cn 8; cf. Gl Frieden 1b
pauperibus versteht ein Übersetzer von Cnut, unrichtig die späte Pluralendung und Bedeutungsentwicklung hineintragend. Zu bonda s. o. Einl. 20a. E.
One translator of Cnut understands pauperibus, wrongly reading into the word the late plural ending and development of meaning. On bonda see above Introduction 20a. E.
This clause does not appear in V Atr.; cf. II Cn. 8; Wulfstan, p. 271 f.
bonda is a Scandinavian loan word, cf. Icel. bondi.
